data.long_meaning: In Greek, Arola means 'River of God'. This name is derived from the Greek word 'aros', meaning 'god', and 'laos', meaning 'people' or 'river'. In the Bible, rivers are often used as symbols of God's presence, guidance, and provision. The name Arola carries the meaning “River of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arola usually hope their child will grow to embody river of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: ערולה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name of biblical significance, derived from the Hebrew word ערול (arul) meaning 'blemish, flaw'. The feminine form ערולה (arulah) denotes 'unblemished, pure'. This name can be found in various biblical contexts, such as Leviticus 22:20, which speaks of the requirement for the burnt offering to be unblemished.

in_greek.name: Αρόλα
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek form of the Hebrew name ערולה (arulah). The name Αρόλα (Arola) shares the same meaning as the Hebrew form, signifying 'pure, unblemished'. This name is not directly mentioned in the New Testament but is reminiscent of several Greek names in the Bible, such as Αρουσαια (Arousaias) and Αροδιοτης (Arodiotes), which convey similar meanings.

in_latin.name: Arola
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the Hebrew and Greek names ערולה (arulah) and Αρόλα (Arola). The name Arola preserves the original meaning of the Hebrew and Greek forms, which is 'unblemished'. This name is not directly mentioned in the Latin Vulgate but can be found in various Latin Christian texts and writings.

in_english.name: Arola
in_english.long_meaning: The English form of the Hebrew name ערולה (arulah) and its derivatives in other languages. The name Arola is a modern English variation of the original Hebrew, Greek, and Latin forms, which all convey the meaning 'unblemished, pure'. This name is not directly mentioned in the English Bible but can be found in various Christian texts and writings.
